body:
Three fixes from field use (lessons 347, 349, 350). Built on Codex; re-applied on 1.46.0.

## What
- A `provider-limit` verdict now comes only from the provider's own error event, or a standalone final stderr line on a failed exit. Text echoed from a context file (a test that quotes the limit message) is never a quota signal, and a successful exit never is. `tests/field-lesson-347.test.mjs`.
- `integrate`: when every declared output exists on disk, a missing result key is a warning that names the parsed keys instead of a refusal; `--accept-result-shape` records it; a missing output still refuses, and `--accept-failed-checks` still does not bypass that. `tests/field-lesson-349.test.mjs`; the worker-skills test updated to the new rule.
- `ship --branch` refuses a branch with no commits over its base (`branch-not-ahead`) before any check runs; new `swarm clean-branch --from <ref>` copies adds/mods and handles renames and deletes. `tests/field-lesson-350.test.mjs`.
- 1.46.1: package.json, package-lock.json, README/SKILL.md kickoff pins, release-pin tests.

## Mutation check
`swarm mutants --mutants-file docs/_swarm/ae-mutants.json` on the build tree (worktrees/swarm-af): 3/3 killed, 0 survived (the 347 mutant survived once until the exit-0 echoed-text cases were added).
- (347) quota text classified regardless of exit code → killed
- (349) refuse although every output exists → killed
- (350) ship accepts a branch that is not ahead → killed

Full suite on the build tree: 1381 pass / 0 fail (the Codex sandbox cannot run the four sandbox-exec tests; they pass locally).

## Checks
```
check-1 -> passed
```
